title: Simon Willison: Job Applications Co-Written by LLM
description: Willison discusses job applications that were clearly co-written by an LLM, with links to LLM-generated portfolio sites. Observations on how LLMs are being used in professional communication and hiring processes.
author: Simon Willison

title: Simon Willison: Porting Moebius 0.2B Image Inpainting Model to Browser with Claude Code
description: Technical blog post about porting the Moebius 0.2B image inpainting model to run in the browser using Claude Code. Demonstrates practical applications of AI coding assistants in machine learning model deployment.
author: Simon Willison

title: Best AI Coding Agents June 2026: Scored Leaderboard
description: Morph leaderboard results from June 17, 2026 showing Claude Code + Fable 5 at 83.1% and Terminus 2 + Fable 5 at 80.4% on Terminal-Bench 2.1. Benchmark results measuring coding agent performance.
author: Morph

title: Simon Willison: Claude Fable is Relentlessly Proactive
description: Willison's follow-up analysis after two days of experience with Claude Fable 5, emphasizing the model's proactive nature in handling coding tasks and debugging. Part of broader coverage of agentic coding patterns.
author: Simon Willison

title: Simon Willison's Initial Impressions of Claude Fable 5
description: Simon Willison published his initial impressions of Claude Fable 5, describing it as 'relentlessly proactive' and noting it is 'slow, expensive and capable'. The model was noted for its proactive approach to debugging and coding tasks before being made unavailable.
author: Simon Willison

title: Vibe Coding Is Over: What Karpathy's Agentic Engineering Pivot Means
description: Analysis of Karpathy's shift from vibe coding to agentic engineering. By March 2026, 25% of Y Combinator's Winter 2025 batch had codebases that were 95% AI-generated. AI co-authored code contains roughly 1.7 times more major issues than human-written code. Discusses the three role shifts needed: senior engineer as spec author, junior engineer as agent operator, and new code-quality watcher role.
author: Foundra Editorial Team

title: Andrej Karpathy on the Shift from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
description: Karpathy declared 'vibe coding' passé in February 2026 and rebranded the future as 'agentic engineering'. He shifted from 80% manual+autocomplete coding and 20% agents in November 2025 to 80% agent coding and 20% edits+touchups by December 2025. Describes it as the biggest change to his basic coding workflow in ~2 decades of programming.
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: Andrej Karpathy Predicts 2026 as the 'Slopacolypse' Year
description: Karpathy predicted 2026 would be the 'year of the slopacolypse' across GitHub, Substack, ArXiv, X/Instagram, and digital media. Warned about AI-generated content quality issues and the flood of low-quality AI-generated code and content. Also predicted 'AI hype productivity theater' alongside real improvements.
author: Andrej Karpathy
